findings.description: Nit: The current result grammar can report vendor_limit:claude without the concrete AgentEntry lane, while the plan correctly rejects ambiguous provider-only writes; the plan must define how dispatch context supplies agent_id before implementation.
findings.resolution: Specify a lane-resolving observation reporter that carries the selected agent_id alongside legacy provider text, and define bounded behavior when only an ambiguous provider is available.

findings.description: Nit: The plan exposes raw per-model catalog prices but does not yet specify the deterministic model and token assumptions used to produce the scalar policy cost delta.
findings.resolution: Define a request-scoped quote rule with selected model or explicit cheapest-eligible fallback plus fixed token assumptions and provenance; never collapse prices silently.
